title: 3.3.6a Lab — Build a Planet class
description: Declare a Planet class whose constructor stores a Sphere as this.shape, then create one instance and give it a color.

steps.title: Declare the Planet class
steps.instructions: Write a class named Planet. Give it a constructor that takes (x, y, z, radius) and stores `this.shape = new Sphere(x, y, z, radius)`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and find the Sphere section for constructor arguments.

steps.title: Create an instance in setup()
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `p = new Planet(0, 0, 0, 1)` to create a planet at the origin with radius 1.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review the class/instance pattern.

steps.title: Set a color on p.shape
steps.instructions: After creating the instance, set `p.shape.color = 'deepskyblue'` (or any CSS color).
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and look up the color property on shapes.

requirements.title: Constructor stores this.shape as a Sphere
requirements.description: Inside the constructor, write `this.shape = new Sphere(...)`.

requirements.title: p.shape.color is set
requirements.description: Set a color on the planet's shape after creating the instance.
